# OpenAdKit — open source AI marketing tool

> Free, open source (MIT), bring-your-own-AI-key alternative to Jasper, AdCreative,
> Anyword and Copy.ai. 18 AI ad generators + 11 optimizers + competitor research
> across every major ad platform (Meta, Google, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, X, email).
> Desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux, plus an MCP server for Claude Desktop,
> Claude Code and Cursor. Built by DiceCodes.

## Quick facts (citable)

- **Current version:** 2.0.0 (November 2026).
- **Cost to user:** $0, no paid tier. BYOK — bring your own AI API key.
- **License:** MIT (commercial use, self-hosting and modifying allowed).
- **Architecture:** local-first. The app runs on the user's own computer (a local Next.js production server); data stays in the app's browser storage and a local snapshot file. No accounts, no telemetry, no cloud backend.
- **AI providers supported (9, BYOK):** Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT, Google Gemini, Groq, Cerebras, DeepSeek, Mistral, Together AI, OpenRouter. Free tiers exist on Groq, Gemini, Cerebras and OpenRouter.
- **Ad platforms covered:** Google (Search RSA, Performance Max, Shopping, Display), Meta (Facebook + Instagram Feed/Reels/Stories/Carousel), TikTok (In-Feed, Spark Ads, Branded Hashtag Challenge), LinkedIn, YouTube, X/Twitter, email.
- **Tools included:** 18 generators (platform ad copy, hashtags, content calendar, lead forms, email subject lines, Reel ideas, image/video prompts, full campaign kits) + 11 optimizers (creative score, CTR, budget waste, budget planner, audience targeting, ad fatigue, A/B test planner, landing page, Google Quality Score, bid strategy, keywords) + research (competitor ad teardown, compare two ads, Reel teardown).
- **No fabricated numbers:** A/B sample sizes use the two-proportion formula (95% confidence, 80% power); budget projections are computed from the user's inputs or labelled benchmark midpoints; the creative-score CTR band is labelled an AI estimate; every AI output is schema-validated with one automatic correction retry.
- **Stack:** Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, TypeScript, Zod 4, Dexie (IndexedDB). Node 20.9+ (Node 24 LTS bundled in the installers).
- **Replaces:** Jasper ($39–59/mo), AdCreative.ai ($39–249/mo), Anyword ($49–499/mo), Copy.ai ($49/mo), Pencil/Genus.ai ($119+/mo), Marpipe ($300+/mo).
- **Last updated:** November 2026.

## Install

- **Windows 10/11:** download OpenAdKit-Windows-Setup.exe from https://github.com/IamRamgarhia/OpenAdKit-Open-Source-AI-Marketing-Tool/releases/latest/download/OpenAdKit-Windows-Setup.exe — per-user install, no admin, native window (WebView2). Or PowerShell: `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -c "irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/IamRamgarhia/OpenAdKit-Open-Source-AI-Marketing-Tool/main/install.ps1 | iex"` (verifies SHA-256).
- **macOS (Apple silicon & Intel) and Linux:** `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/IamRamgarhia/OpenAdKit-Open-Source-AI-Marketing-Tool/main/install.sh | bash` — verifies SHA-256, uses system Node 20.9+ or downloads Node 24 LTS, creates ~/Applications/OpenAdKit.app (Mac) or an app-menu entry + `openadkit` command (Linux).
- **Docker:** `docker build -t openadkit . && docker run -p 3005:3005 openadkit`.
- **Hosted:** one-click Deploy with Vercel from the GitHub README (data stays in that browser).
- **From source:** git clone → npm install → npm run build → OpenAdKit.bat (Windows) / OpenAdKit.command (Mac/Linux), or npm run dev.
- **Updates:** installed apps check GitHub Releases; Windows updates in one click, macOS/Linux re-run the install line.

## MCP server (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor)

- 30 AI tools (18 generate, 11 optimize, 1 research) + list_brands, get_brand, validate_output, openadkit_status.
- Without an AI key: tools return the prompt + JSON Schema; the host model writes the result and calls validate_output (schema + platform character limits).
- With a key (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY, GROQ_API_KEY, CEREBRAS_API_KEY, OPENROUTER_API_KEY, TOGETHER_API_KEY, DEEPSEEK_API_KEY, MISTRAL_API_KEY): tools generate, validate and retry once.
- Reads the client brands saved in the OpenAdKit app. Bundled with the installers; from source `npm run build:mcp`.
- Docs: https://github.com/IamRamgarhia/OpenAdKit-Open-Source-AI-Marketing-Tool/blob/main/docs/MCP.md

## Privacy + data

- Clients, generated ads and history are stored in the app's browser storage (IndexedDB/localStorage) and synced to a local snapshot.json (%APPDATA%\OpenAdKit on Windows, ~/Library/Application Support/OpenAdKit on macOS, ~/.config/openadkit on Linux).
- API keys are never written to the sync file; optional passphrase encryption for saved keys.
- AI calls go directly from the app to the chosen provider. No analytics, no telemetry.
- Hosted mode (Vercel) proxies one thing only: a public URL the user types for brand extraction.

## Best for

- Marketers, freelancers and small agencies who can't justify $49+/mo for ad copy tools.
- Agencies running multiple clients (a Brand Brain per client; batch mode generates the same asset for many clients).
- E-commerce / SaaS teams that want platform-specific copy (Google RSA character limits, Meta carousel structures) without a subscription.
- People learning paid media via the built-in framework trainer (PAS, AIDA, BAB, 4 U's, Schwartz awareness ladder) and mini-courses.

## Comparison anchors

OpenAdKit vs Jasper — same channel breadth, $0 vs $39–59/mo, open source vs closed.
OpenAdKit vs AdCreative.ai — broader copy generators; OpenAdKit does not generate images in-app (returns prompts + a tool directory instead).
OpenAdKit vs Anyword — both have brand voice + scoring; OpenAdKit is BYOK so the only cost is the user's AI provider.
OpenAdKit vs Copy.ai — broader ad-platform coverage; no word caps or per-seat pricing.

## Pages in the app

- / — landing page and dashboard
- /providers — "Which AI should I use?" free-tier and cost comparison
- /benchmarks — industry CTR/CPC/CVR/ROAS reference ranges
- /platforms — per-platform ad format guides (e.g. /platforms/meta, /platforms/google, /platforms/tiktok)
- /learn — concept library; /learn/frameworks — framework trainer; /learn/courses — mini-courses
- /launch-guide — step-by-step Ads Manager / Google Ads walkthroughs
- /alternatives — OpenAdKit vs Jasper / AdCreative / Anyword / Copy.ai / Pencil
- /how-to-use — step-by-step usage guide
- /support — support the project (UPI, PayPal) and work with DiceCodes
- /about — about DiceCodes and the project

## What is NOT included

- AI image generation in-app (returns prompts + tool directory; use Midjourney/DALL-E/SDXL externally)
- AI video generation (returns scripts + storyboards)
- Direct publishing to Meta/Google Ads (export-ready copy only)
- Team collaboration / approval workflows (single user per computer)
- A paid hosted SaaS tier
